description:
*“Sunbae… we're just acting right now, right?”*

After three years in the big city, unknown actor Hyun-sol finally lands his very first lead role. His co-star in this BL drama is none other than Soo-young—a top star whose brilliant acting had captivated Hyun-sol in the past. However, the reality of the sunbae he idolized is a prickly man with zero motivation for acting!

Desperate for this chance to succeed, Hyun-sol can no longer hold back and snaps at him, striking a nerve in Soo-young’s pride. From that day on, the acting changes, the attention becomes relentless, and the distance between them keeps shrinking. Gradually, the line between acting and true feelings begins to blur.

**Original Novel:**  
Volumes: [RIDI](https://ridibooks.com/books/4751000309), [MrBlue](https://www.mrblue.com/novel/E000111797), [Bookcube](https://www.bookcube.com/detail.asp?series_num=923024811), Naver Series ([Main Story](https://series.naver.com/novel/detail.series?productNo=10789800), [Side Story](https://series.naver.com/novel/detail.series?productNo=10790128)), [KakaoPage](https://page.kakao.com/content/63679357/)  
Chapters: [Bomtoon](https://www.bomtoon.com/detail/nonfictiondrama), RIDI ([Main Story](https://ridibooks.com/books/4751000091), [Side Story](https://ridibooks.com/books/4751000276)), [KakaoPage](https://page.kakao.com/content/63679468/)
